tbesh_html:
1) to breathe, blow, sniff at, seethe, give up or lose (life)
1a) (Qal) to breathe, blow
1b) (Pual) to be blown
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to breathe out

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to puff, in various applications (literally, to inflate, blow hard, scatter, kindle, expire; figuratively, to disesteem)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: blow, breath, give up, cause to lose (life), seething, snuff.
